summary: Browse AniList, see where anime streams, and watch from your own sources.
description: A corner of iRiS to browse AniList by season, genre, popularity and your own AniList or MyAnimeList list. A show's page links to where it streams officially; Watch plays in mpv from the sources you add yourself (a Stremio add-on by its address, or a source file), with the source and quality to pick, online subtitles from OpenSubtitles or SubDL, and new-episode alerts. It comes with no video sources.
